promotion_rule: SIGNAL -> EVIDENCE -> VALIDATED_PROBLEM -> BUYER_ACCESS -> COMMERCIAL_TEST -> VERIFIED_PAYMENT -> DELIVERY -> CUSTOMER_PROOF -> REPEATABILITY -> PRODUCTIZATION -> SCALE
global_boundaries: No arm creates a sixth permanent agent
No arm creates a duplicate Company Brain, CRM, scheduler, approval authority, proof ledger or model router
Research never implies relationship, consent or buyer intent
Regulated, licensed or safety-critical delivery uses qualified partner routes unless Dealix authority is independently proven
Customer data reuse requires lawful authority and provenance
Public claims require matching evidence class and permission
